findings.claim: The maximum instrument-tag length arithmetic is off by one: `-instruments-v` is 14 characters, not 13. The resulting maximum is 62 characters and remains safely valid under the stated component bounds.
findings.fix: Correct the explanatory arithmetic from 13/61 to 14/62; no implementation change is needed.

findings.claim: The design requires refusal for graft- or replace-shortened history but acceptance names only a shallow-clone fixture. The normative refusal is sufficiently explicit to implement, though an additional fixture would make this less regression-prone.
findings.fix: Optionally add separate graft/replace-history refusal fixtures.

summary: M-1 is closed: acceptance now names a shallow-clone fixture, its expected refusal, and the unshallow remedy. No material defect remains. The projection accounts for the current manifest keys in the correct case/configuration halves and defines the six-alias join modulo one explicit difference list; compatibility preserves every legacy alias, including the three intentionally reproduced but unsealable configurations; pinned-object identity, legacy resume, extraction, proposal membership, comparison ancestry, and cohort version requirements are coherent. Raw-byte integrity plus the append-only registry makes formatting or line-ending changes visible without putting a digest in the Git ref; mission id `taskrun` fits the current grammars and paths; unpinned case/configuration versions are correctly refused; §10 passes the another-machine test; and the design introduces no unnecessary third abstraction.
